$comment: The brand's illustration style as data: the parts the playground and the site draw (brand/illustration.md says each rule and its source). Colors are token names (an alpha after a slash); the themes are the share images' (image.json). The engine is src/illustrate/.

pixels.$comment: The red pixel grid from the playground's pixels.png (86 by 86, six by six cells): R is home-red, p the pale cell (#FFD6D2 in the file; no token, drawn in home-wash-hover #FFDEDD). A seed reshuffles the cells, keeping the count of each.

stack.$comment: A stack of documents (stack-tall.png 412 by 498, stack-wide.png 626 by 336): a front sheet with nested frames and the pixel grid at a corner, and some 28 sheets behind it stepping back 5 and 4 px.

subjects.stack: A stack of documents, tall or wide (--shape tall|wide). --image puts your picture on the front sheet.
subjects.stacks: The share image's scene: the perspective room with stacks of documents squared up at the sides.
subjects.pixels: The red pixel grid alone (--seed reshuffles it).
subjects.room: The perspective room: a back wall, rings stepping out faster toward the edges, lines from the wall out past the frame.
subjects.tile: The wordmark as a staggered tile, at the theme's faint strength.
subjects.outline: The wordmark huge and hollow along the foot.
subjects.hatch: Fine 45 degree hatching across a floor, a wide stack on it.
subjects.strip: Documents searched: a strip of small squares with a few found in red (--seed moves them).
subjects.panel: The dark agent window with its sample copy.
subjects.scene: The product scene: the red room, stacks at the sides and the agent window in front (the feature layout's stand-in).
